description:
## [1.6.0](https://github.com/Ikuradachi/Kageroll/compare/v1.5.0...v1.6.0) (2026-11-19)

### ✨ New Features

* add Crunchyroll player timing and HUD patches ([7b6f04a](https://github.com/Ikuradachi/Kageroll/commit/7b6f04a519606e90dce48df25963d540fa655e69))
* add Hide feed & show promos patches ([f16e1a6](https://github.com/Ikuradachi/Kageroll/commit/f16e1a64e48c038346363ff03a9d4709b091b79a))
* add player gestures, screen lock, aspect mode, defaults, and remaining time patches ([d86ad1b](https://github.com/Ikuradachi/Kageroll/commit/d86ad1b60e94830547be9ef88664a61964efbc2b))
* add Startup splash and modals patches ([004d9c8](https://github.com/Ikuradachi/Kageroll/commit/004d9c809a5b7ec5d2e79edd370f6566a00665ea))
* add subtitle styling patch ([2d68d70](https://github.com/Ikuradachi/Kageroll/commit/2d68d70a2e040451584369f3bf0ade64346ffa5c))

patches.name: 1080p download quality
patches.description: Upgrades the High offline download quality tier to 1080p and selects the single best matching video track.

patches.name: Allow screenshots
patches.description: Removes FLAG_SECURE from membership card and Compose dialogs to permit screenshots and disables Android 14+ screen capture detection in the Arc reader.

patches.name: Aspect mode cycle & persistence
patches.description: Cycles video aspect modes (Fit, Zoom, Fill) on pinch and remembers the selected mode across sessions.

options.description: Cycles Fit -> Zoom -> Fill -> Fit when pinching out instead of toggling only Fit and Zoom.
Initial video aspect mode before a user pinch selection is saved.

patches.name: ASS subtitle style & margin override
patches.description: Customizes ASS subtitle font scale, bottom margin, outline, shadow, and colors, and adapts subtitle viewport margins to the active video aspect ratio and resize mode.

options.description: Multiplier applied to ASS subtitle font sizes (0.25 to 4.0).
Also scales inline {\fsN} tags on non-positioned dialogue lines (skips lines using \pos or \move).
Vertical offset added to bottom-aligned ASS styles and events (normalized to 720p PlayResY; positive moves subtitles up).
Additional bottom viewport margin in dp passed to the subtitle renderer (positive moves subtitles up).
Overrides ASS style Outline thickness (0.0 to 10.0), or 'default' to keep script values.
Overrides ASS style Shadow depth (0.0 to 10.0), or 'default' to keep script values.
Overrides ASS PrimaryColour (#RRGGBB, #AARRGGBB, or ASS &HAABBGGRR), or 'default' to keep script values.
Overrides ASS OutlineColour (#RRGGBB, #AARRGGBB, or ASS &HAABBGGRR), or 'default' to keep script values.
Replaces Crunchyroll's hardcoded 16:9 Fit margin math with true video aspect ratio and Fit/Zoom/Fill resize-mode awareness, refreshing immediately when resize mode changes.

patches.name: Auto-skip segments
patches.description: Automatically skips intros, recaps, credits, previews, or promos in the video player.

options.description: Automatically skip opening/intro segments.
Automatically skip episode recap segments.
Automatically skip ending credits (preserves post-credits scenes when present).
Automatically skip next-episode preview segments.
Automatically skip promotional segments.

patches.name: Controls auto-hide timeout
patches.description: Customizes the delay before player controls automatically hide, or disables auto-hiding.

options.description: Delay in milliseconds before player controls auto-hide. Set to 0 or less to keep controls visible until toggled.

patches.name: Disable background services
patches.description: Disables background broadcast receivers, schedulers, widget polling, Firebase sessions initialization and service binding, and DataTransport JobScheduler tasks to eliminate background wakeups and idle battery drain.

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Blocks Segment initialization, Mux events, advertising ID lookup, Firebase Analytics pre-init, Crashlytics NDK native loading, Braze session and push flush alarms, and Datadog uploads; disables Firebase Analytics after consent updates, denies automatic Crashlytics uploads, and selects disabled Datadog setup.

patches.name: Hide feed & show promos
patches.description: Hides promotional cards, vertical promo rows, floating action buttons, and show-page promo banners.

options.description: Prevents the CR Arc promotional card from being injected into the home feed.
Hides the top hero banner carousel on the home feed.
Hides standalone game promotional cards in the home feed.
Hides standalone media promotional cards in the home feed.
Hides Crunchyroll Games collection rows from the home feed.
Hides Crunchyroll Manga collection rows from the home feed.
Hides music collection rows from the home feed.
Hides the floating Go Premium button overlay on the home feed.
Hides the floating promotional action button on the home feed.
Hides the floating CR Arc quick-access action button on the home feed.
Hides the cross-promo banner shown on series pages.

patches.name: Hide maturity rating overlay
patches.description: Hides the maturity rating overlay when starting or resuming playback.

patches.name: Manual video quality
patches.description: Replaces the preset quality tiers with manual per-resolution selection and Auto.

patches.name: Picture-in-Picture
patches.description: Enables native Picture-in-Picture playback support.

patches.name: Playback speed
patches.description: Unhides the player's speed menu and expands playback speed options up to 4.0x.

options.description: Highest playback speed multiplier shown in the player speed menu.

patches.name: Player gestures
patches.description: Enables pinch-to-zoom, double-tap-to-seek, and vertical swipe gestures for brightness and volume.

options.description: Allows pinching on the video player to zoom or cycle aspect modes.
Enables double-tapping the left or right side of the player to seek.
Allows swiping vertically on the left side of the player to adjust screen brightness.
Allows swiping vertically on the right side of the player to adjust media volume.

patches.name: Player preference defaults
patches.description: Overrides initial default values for audio language, subtitles, autoplay, cellular streaming, closed captions, audio description, and playback speed.

options.description: Initial player audio locale when no user preference has been saved yet.
Initial player subtitle locale when no user preference has been saved yet.
Initial state for auto-playing the next episode.
Initial state for allowing video streaming over cellular data.
Initial state for showing closed captions when available.
Initial state for audio description tracks.
Initial playback speed multiplier when no user preference has been saved yet.

patches.name: Proxy token requests
patches.description: Routes token acquisition and refresh through your SOCKS proxy, with optional proxy authentication.

options.description: Hostname or IP address only, without scheme, credentials, or port. Use brackets for IPv6.
Explicit port from 1 to 65535. Enter as a string when using a JSON options file.
Optional printable ASCII username (1–255 characters). Credentials are embedded in the patched APK. Leave both credential fields blank for no authentication.
Optional printable ASCII password (1–255 characters). Credentials are embedded in the patched APK. Supply both username and password together.
Logs token HTTP status and exception class names only, under MorpheTokenProxy. Enable for troubleshooting.

patches.name: Remaining time toggle
patches.description: Allows tapping the player timestamp or duration to toggle between elapsed time and remaining time (-MM:SS).

options.description: Displays remaining time (-MM:SS) by default before tapping the timestamp.

patches.name: Screen & orientation lock
patches.description: Adds a screen lock toggle to the player toolbar and locks orientation against accidental rotation.

options.description: Adds a lock icon to the player toolbar that blocks touch input until unlocked via the floating Unlock pill.
Prevents device rotation from exiting or entering fullscreen while the player screen is locked.
Prevents device rotation from automatically toggling fullscreen even when the screen is unlocked.

patches.name: Seek interval
patches.description: Customizes the double-tap and rewind/fast-forward seek interval in the video player.

options.description: Number of seconds to rewind or fast-forward when double-tapping or pressing skip buttons.

patches.name: Skip animated splash
patches.description: Skips the animated startup splash video and its audio focus request, and skips cold-start checkout WebView preloading.

options.description: Skips the 6-second animated splash video and AudioFocus request on startup.
Skips preloading the RazorPay checkout WebView on the main thread during app startup.

patches.name: Suppress bloat workers
patches.description: Forces Google Engage, Continue Watching, Datadog, and OneTrust CMP background workers to return success immediately without performing network requests, disk I/O, or image prefetching.

patches.name: Suppress modals & prompts
patches.description: Suppresses Braze in-app message overlays, Play in-app review prompts, Play in-app update prompts, and the startup notification permission prompt.

options.description: Discards Braze promotional in-app message overlays immediately instead of displaying or deferring them.
Prevents the Google Play in-app review rating prompt from being bound and launched.
Disables Google Play in-app update checks and hides the in-app update prompt banner.
Prevents the automatic POST_NOTIFICATIONS runtime permission prompt on startup.

patches.name: Up Next banner window
patches.description: Customizes how many seconds before the end of an episode the Up Next banner appears.

options.description: Seconds before the end of playback when the Up Next banner appears. Set to 0 to suppress early appearance.
